title: Implement registration snapshot and ACL boundary
objective: Create atomic JSON registration/apply semantics and fixed target binding.
output_format: Go production code, deterministic tests, Windows fidelity backstops, and invariant contract tests.
tool_guidance: Use stdlib JSON and existing project test harnesses; preserve wire and persistence types as stdlib-only.
task_boundaries: Own registration snapshot validation, atomic replacement, target binding, and ACL application; exclude runtime supervision, stop sequencing, and record rotation.
acceptance: Atomic validated generation is the only runtime config source.
Default identity and distribution are resolved only at registration.
decision_closure_reason: Registration binding, JSON snapshot, ACL boundary, and compatibility behavior are fixed by the accepted ADRs and implementation member.
